name: Focused Watchlist — Few Stocks, Many Trades, 1H Timeframe
source: TradingLab YouTube — AI bot trading $30K for 1 month
core_concept: Instead of scanning 30+ movers daily, fix a watchlist of 10 blue-chip stocks and trade them repeatedly on 1H timeframe using supply/demand zones. More trades per stock, fewer stocks total.
watchlist_note: These are the exact 10 stocks from the video. High liquidity, good trends, well-known.

parameters.why_1h: 3H had too few signals. 1H gave ~47 trades in 1 month = ~2-3 per day across 10 stocks.
parameters.max_per_trade: No cap in paper mode. In live: $5,000 max per trade.
parameters.strategy: v8.5 supply/demand with valid structure — same 3-step formula
parameters.market_sentiment: If market is bearish → more shorts. If bullish → more longs.

results_from_video.note: Bot did well in trending markets. Struggled in consolidation.

key_insight: OPPOSITE approach to our current system. We scan 30 movers and trade each once. This strategy watches 10 stocks and trades each 4-7 times per month. More familiarity with each stock's behavior = better zone identification.
when_it_works: Trending markets — higher highs/lows or lower highs/lows
when_it_fails: Consolidating/sideways markets — zones get swept repeatedly
